verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs explicitly describe CDC via reading source binlog/WAL logs to capture INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE changes without full-table scans, directly matching the story (airbyte-docs-15, airbyte-docs-25). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of CDC performance under load and per-connector CDC support details are not shown, and one old community comment raises hard-delete concerns without a concrete documented failure, so it doesn't rise to 'disputed'.
